Flow score · 527 LGAs

Which markets are about to run

Each council area is scored every month on four signals that moved before prices did: listings falling, sales volumes rising, days on market shortening and vendor discounts narrowing. Scores are percentiles against every other market that month. A 90 means tighter selling conditions than 90% of Australia.

Does the score work?

Backtest on every market with 100+ sales a year, scored monthly and compared with its value growth over the following 12 months (Cotality AVM). 2018–2025 was not used to design the score.

Next-12-month value growth by score band 2005–2025
How strongly the score ranked markets, by year rank correlation

By period

Soft or already running?

Average next-12-month growth. High flow = score 60+, low flow = under 40. Past growth split into thirds each month. Markets that were tight and already rising did best in both periods. Among soft markets, the score still separated winners from laggards.

The four signals

  • Sales volume: change in sales over the last 12 months. Rising is good.
  • Listings: change in listings over 12 months. Falling is good.
  • Days on market: change over 6 months. Shortening is good.
  • Vendor discount: change over 6 months. Narrowing is good.

Each signal is ranked against every market that month. The score is the rank of their average.

What the data can and can't tell you

  • It reads selling conditions, not value. Pair it with runway, replacement cost and the clock before buying.
  • It failed in 2019–20 (COVID) and 2010–11, when national shocks swamped local conditions.
  • Small markets are noisy. Keep the sales filter at 100+ unless you are checking a specific town.
  • High yield did not predict growth in testing, so it is not in the score.

Data handling

  • Cotality Market Trends: monthly LGA history 1980–2018 joined to monthly drops Aug 2018 – Jun 2026.
  • Jul 2018 skipped. Changes spanning methodology breaks (Aug 2018, May 2020, Nov 2024) are left out.
  • Rental listings dropped: blank Dec 2023 – Nov 2024.
  • About 60 LGAs renamed by Cotality in Jul 2023 are mapped to current names.
